name: Orshot
description: API and automation service that generates images, PDFs and videos from templates (company-stated: "Automate Image, PDF & Video Generation via API"). Aimed at agencies, brands, startups, developers and marketing teams. Pricing: Free $0, Launch $39/mo, Grow $160/mo, Scale $349/mo, Social Publishing $12/mo per social account, Enterprise on request (company-stated). ~140 estimated users (founder-stated). Founded Mar 2025, UK. 170 active subscriptions. Domain rating 60 (TrustMRR SEO data).

mentions.indieAngle: Same engine for one boring output: Polish invoice/receipt PDFs, real-estate listing cards, or event badges/certificates — sold per render volume. Very NextBento-shaped (Next.js + Stripe metered billing).

whyItPrints: It's the Bannerbear / Placid category — "put this product name and price into that template 5,000 times". Nobody gets excited about it, but every e-commerce and social team has the job, and once templates are wired into a workflow nobody switches. The monthly chart is the kind you want: up almost every month.
